title.description: The page's name as a reader sees it: the facet label's tooltip and the Pages index row

files.description: The page's source, path to UTF-8 text. Paths are segments of letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' joined by '/', never '..'; 1 MiB in total

description.description: One or two sentences on what the page shows, for the Pages index

entry.description: The .js or .mjs file whose default export is the page's React component; defaults to index.js

writes.description: The tables of the owning thread's database the page may write rows to, each 'cairn:~/db/<table>'. A write is made as the verified operator viewing the page, recorded with the page and version; a draft page declares none

services.description: Services the page may call through the bridge's service verb: a project service by its id under .cairn/services/, or its own thread's service by canonical URI (cairn://p/PROJECT/THREAD/services/NAME); none by default

manifest.description: What the page may do beyond reading database rows: write rows of its own thread's tables, and call services

promoted.description: True lists a thread's page in the project's Pages index; a draft on an issue node is never listed
